# Training Data Directory

This directory contains **prepared training/validation/test splits** for ML models.

## Current Status

**No training data splits exist yet.** They will be generated by the ML data pipeline (`packages/ml/data/splitting.py`) from historical data when available.

## Expected Structure

```
training/
├── train.parquet      # 70% - chronological training set
├── validation.parquet # 15% - chronological validation set
├── test.parquet       # 15% - chronological test set (held out)
└── metadata.json      # Split info, timestamps, statistics
```

## Splitting Methodology

**CRITICAL: Time-series data must NOT be randomly shuffled.**

Splits are **chronological**:
- Training: First 70% of time
- Validation: Next 15% of time
- Test: Final 15% of time (held out for final evaluation)

This prevents **data leakage** where future information contaminates training.

## Walk-Forward Evaluation

For robust evaluation, also implement walk-forward splits:
```
Split 1: Train[0:T1] -> Val[T1:T2] -> Test[T2:T3]
Split 2: Train[0:T2] -> Val[T2:T3] -> Test[T3:T4]
...
```

## Generation

Run the pipeline:
```bash
python -m packages.ml.data.splitting \
    --input data/historical/btc_options.parquet \
    --output data/training/ \
    --train-ratio 0.7 --val-ratio 0.15 --test-ratio 0.15
```

## Metadata

Each split includes `metadata.json` with:
- Split timestamps (start/end for each set)
- Row counts
- Feature statistics (mean, std for normalization)
- Target statistics
- Data quality flags
